points.title: 童年与家庭变故
points.description: 狄更斯出生于朴次茅斯的一个海军小职员家庭，是八个孩子中的第二个。童年时期，父亲因债务问题入狱，年幼的狄更斯被迫在伦敦黑鞋油厂工作，这段经历对他后来的创作产生了深远影响。他曾在自传体小说《大卫·科波菲尔》中描述这段经历，展现了童年的贫困与屈辱。这段经历使他深刻理解了社会底层人民的苦难，成为他日后关注社会问题、描写贫富差距的重要素材。
points.descriptionEn: Dickens was born in Portsmouth to a family of eight children, with his father working as a naval clerk. During his childhood, his father was imprisoned for debt, forcing young Dickens to work at a blacking factory in London. This experience profoundly influenced his later works, as he depicted it in his semi-autobiographical novel 'David Copperfield.' The hardship and humiliation of his childhood gave him a deep understanding of the suffering of the lower classes, which became a central theme in his writing about social inequality and poverty.

points.title: 记者生涯与早期创作
points.description: 离开黑鞋油厂后，狄更斯接受了教育，成为一名法庭和议会记者。这段经历使他深入了解了英国司法系统的弊端和社会不公。1833年，他开始以笔名'博兹'发表随笔，1836年出版了第一部作品《博兹随笔集》。同年，他的第一部小说《匹克威克外传》开始连载，大获成功。这一时期，狄更斯在伦敦建立了自己的文学声誉，开始关注社会问题，并通过幽默讽刺的手法揭示社会矛盾。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving the blacking factory, Dickens received education and became a court and parliamentary reporter. This experience gave him deep insights into the flaws of the British legal system and social injustice. In 1833, he began publishing essays under the pseudonym 'Boz,' and in 1836, he published his first work, 'Sketches by Boz.' The same year, his first novel, 'The Pickwick Papers,' began serialization and was a huge success. During this period in London, Dickens established his literary reputation and began focusing on social issues, using humor and satire to expose societal contradictions.

points.title: 创作巅峰与社会关怀
points.description: 这一时期是狄更斯创作的黄金时代，他创作了《雾都孤儿》、《尼古拉斯·尼克尔贝》、《老古玩店》、《马丁·朱述尔维特》等经典作品。1842年，他首次访问美国，对美国社会的奴隶制等问题提出批评。1843年，他创作了《圣诞颂歌》，这部作品确立了现代圣诞节的许多传统。狄更斯通过小说揭露社会不公，倡导改革，成为维多利亚时代最重要的社会评论家之一。他的作品不仅广受欢迎，也推动了英国社会对贫困、儿童权益和司法改革的关注。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked Dickens' creative peak, with masterpieces like 'Oliver Twist,' 'Nicholas Nickleby,' 'The Old Curiosity Shop,' and 'Martin Chuzzlewit' published. In 1842, he first visited America, criticizing issues like slavery in American society. In 1843, he wrote 'A Christmas Carol,' which established many modern Christmas traditions. Through his novels, Dickens exposed social injustices and advocated for reform, becoming one of the most important social commentators of the Victorian era. His works were not only popular but also raised awareness in British society about poverty, children's rights, and judicial reform.

points.title: 成熟作品与编辑事业
points.description: 这一时期，狄更斯创作了《大卫·科波菲尔》、《荒凉山庄》、《小杜丽》、《远大前程》等更为成熟的作品。1850年，他创办并编辑了文学期刊《家常话》，后来又创办《一年四季》，这些期刊不仅发表他的作品，还培养了许多年轻作家。狄更斯开始关注工业革命带来的社会问题，在《荒凉山庄》中揭露司法系统的腐败，在《小杜丽》中批判债务监狱制度。他的创作风格更加成熟，人物刻画更加深刻，对社会问题的探讨也更加深入。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Dickens created more mature works such as 'David Copperfield,' 'Bleak House,' 'Little Dorrit,' and 'Great Expectations.' In 1850, he founded and edited the literary journal 'Household Words,' later launching 'All the Year Round.' These journals not only published his works but also nurtured many young writers. Dickens began to focus on social issues brought by the Industrial Revolution, exposing judicial corruption in 'Bleak House' and criticizing the debt prison system in 'Little Dorrit.' His writing style became more mature, characterizations deeper, and exploration of social issues more profound.

points.title: 晚期创作与公众影响力
points.description: 狄更斯晚年创作了《双城记》、《我们共同的朋友》和《艾德温·德鲁德的秘密》(未完成)等作品。《双城记》以法国大革命为背景，探讨了革命、牺牲与救赎的主题，成为他最受欢迎的作品之一。1865年，他遭遇了斯特恩铁路事故，几乎丧命，这一事件可能影响了他晚年的创作。狄更斯晚年通过公开朗读自己的作品获得了巨大成功，成为维多利亚时代最具影响力的公众人物之一。他的作品不仅改变了小说这一文学形式，也对英国社会产生了深远影响，推动了社会改革和人文关怀。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Dickens wrote 'A Tale of Two Cities,' 'Our Mutual Friend,' and the unfinished 'The Mystery of Edwin Drood.' 'A Tale of Two Cities,' set against the backdrop of the French Revolution, explored themes of revolution, sacrifice, and redemption, becoming one of his most popular works. In 1865, Dickens survived the Staplehurst rail accident, which may have influenced his later writing. In his later years, Dickens achieved great success through public readings of his works, becoming one of the most influential public figures of the Victorian era. His works not only transformed the novel as a literary form but also had a profound impact on British society, promoting social reform and human compassion.

appraisal.zh: 狄更斯通常被视为维多利亚时代最伟大的作家之一，也是社会批判与文学创新的先驱：他以生动人物和引人入胜的故事让普通读者关注贫困、儿童权益与教育，其圣诞故事还塑造了现代圣诞节传统，作品至今被广泛阅读和研究。不过也有研究者指出，他的情节有时过于戏剧化、人物刻画偏于简单，改革主张流于理想化而缺少实际方案，对某些社会问题的处理亦存偏见，后期作品被认为不如早期有力。他既是批判社会不公的激进改革者，又是维护维多利亚价值观的保守派，这种矛盾使他成为理解19世纪英国的重要窗口。
appraisal.en: Dickens is generally regarded as one of the greatest Victorian writers and a pioneer of social criticism and literary innovation, whose vivid characters and compelling stories drew ordinary readers to poverty, children's rights and education, and whose Christmas tales helped shape modern Christmas traditions; his works are still widely read and studied. Yet researchers also note that his plots can be overly dramatic, his characterizations somewhat simplistic, his reform proposals idealistic and short on practical solutions, his handling of some social issues biased, and his later works less powerful than the early ones. At once a radical critic of social injustice and a conservative upholder of Victorian values, he remains a key window onto nineteenth-century Britain.

supporter.zh: 狄更斯被赞誉为维多利亚时代最伟大的作家之一，他的作品深刻揭示了社会不公，推动了英国的社会改革。他通过生动的 characters 和引人入胜的故事，使普通读者关注贫困、儿童权益、教育等社会问题。他的圣诞故事如《圣诞颂歌》不仅创造了现代圣诞节的传统，也唤起了人们对慈善和善良的重视。狄更斯的作品具有永恒的艺术价值，至今仍被广泛阅读和研究，他对人性的深刻洞察和对社会正义的不懈追求，使他成为文学史上最具影响力的作家之一。
supporter.en: Dickens is celebrated as one of the greatest writers of the Victorian era, whose works profoundly exposed social injustices and drove social reform in Britain. Through vivid characters and compelling stories, he made ordinary readers aware of issues like poverty, children's rights, and education. His Christmas tales, particularly 'A Christmas Carol,' not only established modern Christmas traditions but also emphasized the importance of charity and kindness. Dickens' works possess enduring artistic value, still widely read and studied today. His profound insights into human nature and relentless pursuit of social justice make him one of the most influential figures in literary history.

critic.zh: 批评者指出狄更斯的作品存在情节过于戏剧化、人物刻画有时过于简单化的倾向。他的社会改革主张有时被批评为过于理想化，缺乏实际解决方案。此外，狄更斯对某些社会问题的处理方式也受到质疑，如他对美国奴隶制的批评有时带有偏见。他的后期作品被一些评论家认为不如早期作品有力，艺术成就有所下降。尽管如此，这些批评并不减损狄更斯作为重要社会评论家和小说家的地位，只是提醒我们评价历史人物需要全面客观的视角。
critic.en: Critics point out that Dickens' works sometimes feature overly dramatic plots and somewhat simplistic characterizations. His social reform proposals have been criticized as overly idealistic, lacking practical solutions. Additionally, Dickens' treatment of certain social issues has been questioned, such as his biased criticism of American slavery. Some critics argue that his later works lack the power of his earlier ones, showing a decline in artistic achievement. Nevertheless, these criticisms do not diminish Dickens' importance as a social commentator and novelist, merely reminding us that historical figures should be evaluated with comprehensive and objective perspectives.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，狄更斯被定义为维多利亚时代社会变革的重要推动者和文学创新的先驱。他的作品不仅反映了工业革命时期英国社会的剧烈变化，也塑造了现代小说的叙事方式。狄更斯的名字已成为社会批判的同义词，他的 characters 如斯克鲁奇、费根等已成为文化符号。在流行文化中，他的作品被无数次改编为电影、电视剧和舞台剧，影响跨越国界和时代。狄更斯遗产的复杂性在于，他既是批判社会不公的激进改革者，也是维护维多利亚时代价值观的保守派，这种矛盾性使他成为理解19世纪英国社会文化的重要窗口。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Dickens is defined as a significant driver of social change in the Victorian era and a pioneer of literary innovation. His works not only reflected the dramatic transformations of British society during the Industrial Revolution but also shaped the narrative methods of the modern novel. Dickens' name has become synonymous with social criticism, and his characters like Scrooge and Fagin have become cultural symbols. In popular culture, his works have been adapted into films, TV series, and plays countless times, with influence transcending borders and eras. The complexity of Dickens' legacy lies in his dual identity: both a radical reformer criticizing social injustice and a conservative upholding Victorian values, making him an important window for understanding 19th-century British society and culture.

self.zh: 这是最好的时代，这是最坏的时代；这是智慧的年代，这是愚蠢的年代；这是信仰的时期，这是怀疑的时期；这是光明的季节，这是黑暗的季节；这是希望的春天，这是绝望的冬天；我们拥有一切，我们一无所有。
self.en: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness, it was the epoch of belief, it was the epoch of incredulity, it was the season of Light, it was the season of Darkness, it was the spring of hope, it was the winter of despair.
